verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor (AMD) published spec listing memory type, capacity ceiling, or bandwidth for the AI Max+ 395 — the AMD product page snippets included cover TDP, NVMe, displays, OS support but omit memory specs entirely. The only memory bandwidth detail (quad DDR5-8000) comes from a community HN comment, not a vendor source, so it cannot satisfy the 'vendor's own numbers' requirement.
